raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Consultant - Infosys
Aug 2022 - Present
Infosys
Ensured regulatory compliance for a global banking client by managing critical compliance timelines, reducing risk exposure.
Implemented and managed payment scheme rulebook updates including SEPA, CHAPS, and T2/Euro, ensuring seamless regulatory transitions.
Administered the authorized payment data store by sourcing and provisioning ISO 20022-compliant payment messages and data attributes to support
downstream processing and reporting.
-Supported ISO 20022 migration initiatives, including payment message analysis, data mapping and alignment of MT/MX message requirements across
systems.
-Supported Regulatory Reporting by analyzing, validating, and provisioning payments data in accordance with regulatory requirements, ensuring data
accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
Gathered, analyzed, and translated stakeholder requirements into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents
(FRDs) and detailed functional specifications to guide successful product development.
Drafted comprehensive EPICS and User Stories aligned with business objectives and end-user needs, streamlining Agile development processes.
Drove backlog prioritization and roadmap planning based on regulatory mandates, customer requirements, operational efficiency goals, and
implementation dependencies.
Conducted impact assessments, gap analysis, and data mapping activities for payment transformation initiatives, ensuring functional alignment and
readiness across dependent systems.
Actively managed project timelines, ensured prompt issue resolution, and mitigated potential risks to maintain project delivery schedules.
Coordinated cross-functional teams and stakeholders, effectively managing expectations and serving as the primary communication liaison.
Mentored junior Product Owners, fostering their professional growth and improving team capability and performance.
